title: Irrational Numbers & Proof by Contradiction

hero.headline: Numbers That Never End Neatly
hero.subtext: √2, √3, √5 jaise numbers ko fraction (p/q) mein kabhi exactly nahi likha ja sakta — aur ye hum prove kar sakte hain!

story.text: Irrational numbers ka decimal expansion kabhi khatam nahi hota aur na hi repeat karta hai — jaise √2 = 1.41421356... hamesha chalta rehta hai. FTA ka use karke hum prove kar sakte hain ki √2 ko p/q (fraction) form mein likhna impossible hai.

explanation.content: Proof by contradiction ka tareeka: pehle assume karo ki √2 rational hai (yani p/q form mein likha ja sakta hai, jahan p,q co-prime integers hain aur q≠0).
Phir dikhao ki ye assumption ek contradiction (galti) ki taraf le jaata hai — matlab p aur q dono even nikalte hain, jo co-prime hone ke against hai.
Isliye hamara original assumption galat tha — √2 irrational hai.
√2 ≠ p/q for any integers p, q (q≠0)

steps: Assume √2 = p/q, jahan p,q co-prime hain
Isse p² even hai, isliye p bhi even hai (p = 2m)
Isse q² bhi even hai, isliye q bhi even hai
Par p aur q dono even hain — ye co-prime hone ke contradiction hai!
Isliye humara assumption galat tha → √2 irrational hai ✓

questions.question: √2 irrational hai — ye prove karne ke liye kaunsa method use hota hai?
questions.explanation: Hum √2 ko rational assume karke ek contradiction tak pahunchte hain, jisse prove hota hai ki wo irrational hai.

questions.question: Har irrational number ka decimal expansion terminate ya repeat karta hai.
questions.explanation: Galat — irrational numbers ka decimal expansion na terminate karta hai na repeat karta hai.

questions.question: Agar p² even hai, to hum kya keh sakte hain p ke baare mein?
questions.explanation: Agar p odd hota, to p² bhi odd hota. Isliye p² even hone ka matlab hai p bhi even hai.

notes: Irrational numbers ka decimal kabhi terminate/repeat nahi karta
Proof by contradiction: rational assume karo → contradiction dikhao → isliye irrational
√2, √3, √5, π sab classic irrational numbers hain
summary: Contradiction proof ek powerful tool hai jisse hum kisi bhi √p (p prime) ko irrational prove kar sakte hain.
